description: This file defines the public API for GPIO drivers in the Zephyr RTOS, including macros, data structures, function prototypes, and inline functions for configuring and controlling GPIO pins and ports, as well as managing callbacks and interrupts.

methods.name: gpio_is_ready_dt
methods.description: Checks if the GPIO port specified in devicetree is ready for use.

methods.name: gpio_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt triggering for a specific GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt
methods.description: Configures interrupt for a GPIO pin specified in devicetree.

methods.name: gpio_pin_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags.

methods.name: gpio_pin_configure_dt
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin from devicetree with extra flags.

methods.name: gpio_port_get_direction
methods.description: Retrieves the direction (input/output) of pins in a port.

methods.name: gpio_pin_is_input
methods.description: Checks if a pin is configured as input.

methods.name: gpio_pin_is_input_dt
methods.description: Checks if a devicetree-specified pin is input.

methods.name: gpio_pin_is_output
methods.description: Checks if a pin is configured as output.

methods.name: gpio_pin_is_output_dt
methods.description: Checks if a devicetree-specified pin is output.

methods.name: gpio_pin_get_config
methods.description: Gets current configuration flags of a pin.

methods.name: gpio_pin_get_config_dt
methods.description: Gets configuration flags of a devicetree pin.

methods.name: gpio_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads raw physical levels of all pins in a port.

methods.name: gpio_port_get
methods.description: Reads logical levels of all pins, considering active low configuration.

methods.name: gpio_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets raw physical levels for selected pins.

methods.name: gpio_port_set_masked
methods.description: Sets logical levels for selected pins, considering active low.

methods.name: gpio_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specified pins to high level.

methods.name: gpio_port_set_bits
methods.description: Sets specified pins to active level.

methods.name: gpio_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specified pins to low level.

methods.name: gpio_port_clear_bits
methods.description: Sets specified pins to inactive level.

methods.name: gpio_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specified pins.

methods.name: gpio_pin_get_raw
methods.description: Reads raw physical level of a pin.

methods.name: gpio_pin_get
methods.description: Reads logical level of a pin, considering active low.

methods.name: gpio_pin_set_raw
methods.description: Sets raw physical level of a pin.

methods.name: gpio_pin_set
methods.description: Sets logical level of a pin, considering active low.

methods.name: gpio_pin_toggle
methods.description: Toggles the level of a pin.

methods.name: gpio_init_callback
methods.description: Initializes a gpio_callback structure.

methods.name: gpio_add_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for GPIO events.

methods.name: gpio_add_callback_dt
methods.description: Registers a callback for a devicetree-specified GPIO.

methods.name: gpio_remove_callback
methods.description: Removes a registered callback.

methods.name: gpio_remove_callback_dt
methods.description: Removes a callback for devicetree-specified GPIO.

methods.name: gpio_get_pending_int
methods.description: Returns pending GPIO interrupts for a device.
